profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer
profile.summary: Full-Stack Developer with a diversified skill set and 5� years of experience in a startup environment, cross-functionally utilized in the areas of web development, UX design, software programming, and MI/ML.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Key developer for Zenurian, a Machine Learning (ML) driven, web-based cybersecurity tool for real-time threat detection sponsored by the Dept. of Navy. Developed the ML engine using Apache Spark and Scala, backend database using MongoDB and PostgreSQL, and Java-based web service using Apache Tomcat, Java Servlets and MyBatis integrated with JQuery-based front-end template engine using Bootstrap, CSS, Vega, FontAwesome and JSChart API.
• Implemented ML analytics functions for real-time anomaly detection and alert generation as well as risk analytics function using Apache Spark in Scala for static and streaming data. Designed and implemented ML pipeline GUI using JavaEE. Created and tested ML applications using Apache Zeppelin and Jupyter Notebook.
• Designed the page layout of web GUI in Zenurian and identified the page workflow and action items. Componentized reusable GUI widgets via Java Servlet Pages (JSP) and allocate the appropriate libraries and data files based on the widgets’ content and purpose. Implemented run-time graphing functions using Vega with JSP and JQuery with AJAX integration with PostgreSQL.
• Designed and implemented the database framework of Zenurian based on MyBatis: analyzed use cases and identified appropriate data types. Established data tables, their properties and their inter-relationships. Created ER diagrams using draw.io.
• Implemented Zenurian’s user management functions and role-based access using Tomcat’s security realm APIs: defining user properties, roles, privileges, and page/ resource access control permissions. Implemented GUI user functions using JQuery integrated with JavaServlets and JDBC/MyBatis database functions.

positions.title: Instructor Associate/Freelance Contractor
positions.description:
• Provided support for a seven-member instructional team in teaching 60 associates of Capital One’s CODA program to learn the fundamentals of web development and coding.
• Created multiple coding exercises to test and challenge the CODA associates’ comprehension of daily materials and constructed mini-lectures that highlighted technologies and skills not taught in the program.
• Assessed numerous web applications and read multiple codes created by the associates to formulate relevant data that tracked their skills and progress throughout the entire program. 
• Assisted in troubleshooting associates’ computer/proxy issues as well as debugging problematic codes.
• Evaluated and screened coding submissions of potential candidates for Cognizant’s pilot web development program.

positions.title: Web Development Immersive Student
positions.description:
• Attended an intensive 480-hour full-stack web development course that focused on: MVC frameworks, data modeling,  object-oriented programming, and implementation of JavaScript and Ruby across popular frameworks. 
• Collaborated on a MEAN (Mongoose, Express, Angular, Node) stack application that was used to locate events and social activities that were happening in a specific area of the user’s choice. Application utilized a RESTful server as well as an integrated 3rd Party API. 
• Drafted a mock prototype of a sneaker-shopping website that was built on a three-model Ruby on Rails application. The application had specific admin-only CRUD functionality implementation in addition to a basic cart system. 
• Created an original block puzzle game using the React framework that had game logic coded in vanilla JavaScript and utilized DOM manipulation to have the game react in real-time to the user’s action.
